name: I Pity The Fool
look: Photo of Mr. T, with his trademark mohawk, full beard, hoop earrings and heaps of gold chains, wearing a black leather vest and a gold bracelet. He scowls and points straight at the camera. A big sparkly medallion reading "VOX" hangs on his chest.
use: Mr. T scolds someone for a foolish choice. The top text says "I pity the fool" and the bottom names who, usually someone doing something obviously dumb.
slots: who does the foolish thing (bottom text)
examples: Who replies all to the whole company
Who doesn't save before the boss fight
describe: mr t pointing at you with gold chains and a mohawk
muscle man with a mohawk and gold chains pointing angrily
bearded guy in a leather vest points at the camera scowling
a-team actor pointing his finger with lots of gold necklaces
tough guy pointing at you with a vox medallion
origin: His catchphrase "I pity the fool" comes from his role as Clubber Lang in Rocky III (1982).
